import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
import { extractDiagnostic } from '../src/diagnostic.mjs'

const log = [...Array.from({ length: 2000 }, (_, index) => `INFO: step ${index}`), 'ERROR: database unavailable'].join('\n')
console.log(log)
assert.equal(extractDiagnostic(log), 'database unavailable')
